notes.title: CG Gallery + exciting future updates
notes.content: [h2]CG gallery[/h2][p]Heart of Summer now has a CG gallery which you can access from the main menu when you start the game.  In "Memories" you can collect all your most memorable summer moments![/p][p]Unfortunately, implementing this post-launch means that if you have played a certain route previously, you have to replay each CG specific scene after the update to unlock the related images. Please note that certain CGs may not unlock before you have seen the different versions of it.[/p][p]We apologize for the inconvenience this causes to players, but maybe you'll find some small CG you missed along the way.[/p][h3]Japanese translation?[/h3][p]On a side note concerning the Japanese translation, due to quality assurance, progress has been slower than expected, but is currently underway. We can't give a date yet, but players may expect it SOON.[/p][h3]Future content[/h3][p]In addition to other minor visual tweaks, Heart of Summer is now at its best state since its launch. And the good news is that we are nowhere close to being done with Heart of Summer. In fact, [u]we have new gaming content updates coming[/u] which are much bigger and more exciting than the CG gallery (as essential as that is). We'll keep you updated on that as we inch closer to releasing them.[/p][p]I want to thank all players thus far for playing Heart of Summer.[/p][p]The summer isn't over yet. While we go forward to bring you more content, we'd love to hear from you what you think about the game. Like, you know... what girl you like or something.[/p][p]See you at school![/p][p][i]Ake[/i][/p][p][/p][p]P.S. Takao wants to go to the game center again[/p]

notes.title: Upcoming Japanese version release of "Heart of Summer"
notes.content:
We’re currently working on the Japanese translation to bring the game to even more players.

The release is scheduled for early summer! 💗

Japanese players, please stay tuned and wait just a little longer!

Exciting updates are coming soon! 🌞

notes.title: Heart of Summer launch notes for players
notes.content:
As "Heart of Summer" has just launched I'm paying especially close attention to how it's received by players. I've playtested the game to the best of my ability prior to release, so there [i]shouldn't[/i] be any problems that prevent the game from functioning.

However, since I made this game with limited resources there are certain elements that are beyond my control. The game uses TyranoBuilder as its engine and there seems to be a slight problem with the audio configuration menu, which may or may not make certain sounds effects too low volume in proportion to other sound effects. If you come across this problem then [b]try loading the save, or preferably restarting the game[/b].

[u]Because of this issue, I generally recommend adjusting your system volume (meaning your headphones or speakers) instead of the in-game volume, if possible.[/u]

I am monitoring feedback closely and around the clock, so if anyone comes across any bugs or other issues, [i]please[/i] let me know on the Heart of Summer forums, or message me, or send me an email. I will do my very best to fix crucial issues immediately, so that all players can enjoy a smooth launch gaming — or rather, dating — experience. ːaoichanː

I want to thank all players and especially the brave early buyers who dare to buy the game with no prior reviews to back their judgement. 

Sincerely,
Ake
email: akehabara@outlook.com
